brief:
Israeli airstrikes killed at least eight Palestinians, including five police officers, in two separate attacks across the Gaza Strip on Sunday, according to medics and the Hamas-run interior ministry, Al-Monitor reported. The strikes targeted different locations in the territory.

The casualties included members of Gaza's police force, which operates under Hamas administration. Medical officials and interior ministry representatives confirmed the death toll from the Sunday operations.
dek: CAIRO, Nov 1 (Reuters) - Israeli strikes killed at least eight Palestinians, including five police officers, in the Gaza Strip in two separate attacks on Sunday, according to medics and the Hamas-run interior ministry.
title: Israeli strikes kill eight Palestinians in Gaza
